'''Roba sausage''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] made from a [[Roba/Legends|Roba]] and usually served with [[Gravy/Legends|gravy]]. It was the favorite food of [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Ordo Skirata]].<ref name="tc" />
